EC1: - Patient is EBV (epstein barr virus)-negative on serology.
EC2: - Patient is HIV- positive [OR] or suffering from chronic viral hepatitis.
EC3: - Patient is CMV (cytomegalo virus) -negative [AND] and receiving a kidney from a CMV-positive donor.
EC5: - Patient with prior kidney transplant [OR] or [NOT] non-renal solid organ transplant.
EC6: - Patient has a known contraindication to any of the protocol-specified treatments.
EC7: - Patient had been diagnosed with a malignancy within 5 years prior to study entry, excluding [NOT] non-metastatic basal [OR] or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.
EC9: - Female patients [AND] with a positive pregnancy test.
